summary: Verified and retained PR 1829's narrow fix for vacuous follower-local backup success. The original DeepSeek-V4 SWA position corruption and NaN remain unverified and no speculative additional source change was made.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before evidence: empty follower-local transfer set produced completed_tokens=0 instead of 128; the other two boundary cases passed.
Passing-after evidence: empty follower-local work and successful sidecars acknowledge 128 tokens, while a partial sidecar failure remains unsuccessful; 3 passed.
Adjacent pool assembly and Mooncake group semantics; 17 passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: The proven change is host-side completion accounting. The architecture-specific test requires unavailable DeepSeek-V4 weights and TP=4 or the reported TP=8 topology; an unrelated one-GPU smoke was not used as evidence.

remaining_limitations: No DeepSeek-V4 FULL+SWA hierarchical-cache backup, eviction, large-prefix restore, or subsequent SWA write-position check was run.
No kv-canary TAIL_K_SWA evidence or independent position oracle was available.
No fresh Mooncake namespace multi-rank replicated-object test was possible on the single assigned GPU.
No downstream logits or sampling-probability test establishes removal of the reported NaN.
The failing base regression proves completed_tokens=0 on a follower only; it does not reproduce a successful restore with stored position 512 where 8448 was expected.
